systemAndFonts.name: FFmpeg (Debian build)
systemAndFonts.note: Debian package build enabled GPL components (--enable-gpl --enable-libx264). Used server-side on user-owned media; bundling/redistributing this build would trigger GPL obligations.

systemAndFonts.name: Noto Sans (font)
systemAndFonts.note: Bundled for canvas preview + FFmpeg drawtext; OFL permits redistribution with the license included.

systemAndFonts.name: Noto Sans Tamil (font)
systemAndFonts.note: Same OFL terms; required for Tamil caption rendering.

systemAndFonts.name: Geist / Geist Mono (next/font/google)
systemAndFonts.note: Loaded by next/font at build time per Vercel's Geist font (OFL).

systemAndFonts.name: System Python 3 (runtime)
systemAndFonts.note: Invoked isolated (-I) with inline standard-library scripts; NO third-party Python packages are bundled.
